discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its physiological role, leading to GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has transformed the treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity, with major cardiovascular and renal benefits. It has already won the Lasker (2024), Breakthrough, and Gairdner prizes, and it has a clear basic-science origin of the kind the Karolinska committee usually favors. Habener, Mojsov and Drucker identified GLP-1, characterized it and established its incretin action.
